messages:
Erin: Heads up — noticed ~$31,240 in unallocated GPU spend in project redwood-playground-us-west1 this billing cycle. alert from billing bot flagged it. any idea which team/automation created those instances?

billing-bot: Automated alert — Project 'redwood-playground-us-west1' has 1,162 GPU hours untagged since 2026-02-10. Estimated cost: $31,240. Suggest tag backfill or stop resource.

Michael: @erin thanks. I'll check autoscaler logs. My guess: ephemeral CI jobs spawned untagged nodes when preemptible pool hit limit.

Ashley: We shipped a new load-test job last week that spins up a Tesla T4 pool w/out tags (my bad). It's in infra/load-tests pipeline. We'll patch today.

Erin: Can you add cost center tags "team:platform" and "env:test" and backfill? Finance needs mapping for chargeback before month close.

Michael: Quick diagnostic command if anyone needs it:
``
gcloud compute instances list --filter="zone:(us-west1-*) AND labels.team="" AND labels.env="" AND machineType:(t4)" --format="table(name,zone,machineType,labels)"
```
Will run and start a backfill script that sets labels and updates our billing export.

Ashley: Will also add a pre-commit hook in the pipeline to enforce tagging and a failing check if tags missing. ETA EOD.

Sophie: FYI if you want to retroactively attribute costs, we can update the ledger with tag_map: platform->platform-team, but need approval from @erin.

Erin: Approved. Please update ledger and send a note to teams to expect a corrected invoice line item. Also create an alert playbook so this doesn't happen again. :memo:

Michael: Created issue #INFRA-729 and added runbook link. /cc @ashley

Ashley: Patch merged. Running backfill, will post results in this thread when done. :rocket:

billing-bot: Backfill complete — 1,162 instances updated, cost center label applied. Ledger updated with mapping 'platform-team'. Final adjustment shows $31,240 reattributed to 'platform'.

Erin: Thanks everyone. Closing once we get confirmation on invoice. :thumbsup:
